items.headline: Laura Rutledge shouts out her old crew during 'Nation on Location'
items.description: ESPN reporters preview the biggest Week 2 matchups from around the nation as former SEC Nation host Rutledge sends a special message to the team.

items.headline: SEC Nation spins the wheel on Week 2's biggest questions
items.description: The SEC Nation crew spins a wheel featuring all 16 SEC teams as host Matt Barrie puts them in the hot seat to make their case with 20 seconds on the clock.

items.headline: Bill Connelly's Week 2 preview: Big Ten-SEC challenge, early conference tests
items.description: Bluebloods have a chance at the early-season's biggest win. Big 12 and SEC have early conference challenges, and the G6 has an elimination weekend.

items.headline: No. 20 Utah hosts Arkansas in Week 2
items.description: Arkansas (1-0) at No. 20 Utah (1-0), Sept. 12 at 10:15 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: SEC schedules vote about whether to expel LSU, amends lawsuit
items.description: The SEC has filed an amended complaint against LSU regarding its potential plans to add ex-NFL players and scheduled a vote on whether to expel the Tigers.
items.byline: Pete Thamel and Mark Schlabach and Dan Murphy
